summary: 14 checks executed (6 backend, 8 browser) covering all 8 acceptance-matrix criteria. All passed. No bugs found.

checks.name: login-unlocks-appraise-page
checks.evidence: Filled shop-password-input, clicked unlock-button, item-photo-slot and label-photo-slot visible on Appraise page after login

checks.criterion: Inventory loads with stats and items after login
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_and_inventory.py::test_inventory_and_stats_require_and_return_after_auth
checks.evidence: Unauthed GET /api/inventory -> 401; after login GET /api/inventory -> 200 list>=1; GET /api/inventory/stats -> 200 with total_items/available_items/sold_items/all_time_raised/potential_value

checks.criterion: Inventory loads with stats and items after login
checks.name: inventory-loads-with-stats-and-items
checks.evidence: GET /api/inventory and /api/inventory/stats returned 200 on nav to Inventory; stats-grid + 4 stat cards visible; inventory-list rendered with >0 inventory-item-* cards

checks.criterion: Sort options reorder the inventory grid
checks.name: inventory-sort-reorders-grid
checks.evidence: price-desc: card prices non-increasing; price-asc: non-decreasing; category sort: displayed title order matched API-computed category+title ordering

checks.name: inventory-category-and-availability-filters
checks.evidence: Category filter narrowed card count to match API-side category count; availability=sold showed only sold-badge-* cards matching API sold count; availability=available showed 0 sold badges matching API available count

checks.criterion: Scan tag looks up by SKU and opens the item
checks.name: test_tscheck_scan_sku_lookup.py::test_lookup_unknown_sku_returns_404
checks.evidence: GET /api/inventory/lookup?sku=000000000000 -> 404 {detail: No item with that barcode}

checks.criterion: Scan tag looks up by SKU and opens the item
checks.name: test_tscheck_scan_sku_lookup.py::test_lookup_known_sku_returns_200_and_matches_created_item
checks.evidence: POST /api/inventory -> 201 with 12-digit sku; GET /api/inventory/lookup?sku=<sku> -> 200 matching created id/title

checks.criterion: Scan tag looks up by SKU and opens the item
checks.name: scan-tag-sku-lookup
checks.evidence: Manual SKU 000000000000 -> toast 'No item matches that barcode', dialog stayed open; manual SKU of fixture item -> navigated to /tag/<id> showing correct tag-title

checks.criterion: Scanner also accepts a QR-style /tag/<id> URL payload
checks.name: scanner-accepts-tag-url-payload
checks.evidence: Manual input of https://example-host.test/tag/<id>?ga=GA-1 pasted into manual-sku-input + Find navigated directly to /tag/<id> with correct tag-title

checks.criterion: Gift Aid sale allocation records and displays
checks.name: test_tscheck_giftaid_sell_allocation.py::test_sell_with_giftaid_ref_sets_and_clears_allocation
checks.evidence: PATCH /api/inventory/{id}/sell {sold:true, sold_price:50} -> 200 status=sold, sold_giftaid_ref=GA-TSCHECK-01; {sold:false} -> 200 status=available, sold_giftaid_ref=null

checks.criterion: Gift Aid sale allocation records and displays
checks.name: giftaid-sale-allocation-banner
checks.evidence: Created item with giftaid_ref, sell-dialog showed 'This sale will be allocated to Gift Aid GA-QA-BANNER-01', after confirming sale sold-banner + sold-giftaid text read 'Allocated to Gift Aid GA-QA-BANNER-01'

checks.criterion: Price tag renders barcode + QR and photo gallery on the item page
checks.name: price-tag-barcode-qr-and-gallery
checks.evidence: tag-barcode svg rendered with >5 rects, tag-qr canvas visible, item-gallery showed gallery-image-0/1; zero console errors, zero >=400 responses on the page
